description: Amendment of the Quarantine and Prevention of Diseases Ordinance           No.3 of 1897
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Quarantine and Prevention of Diseases Ordinance No.3 of 1897 is the principal legislation in Sri Lanka governing the prevention of the spread of communicable diseases and the implementation of quarantine measures. However, it has been observed that the risk of transmission of communicable diseases across borders has also increased significantly due to the significant increase in international and domestic movement of persons, goods and services at present, and that frequent international travel and international trade are leading to the rapid spread of communicable diseases between countries. Accordingly, the Cabinet approval had been granted in the year 2016 to amend the Quarantine and Prevention of Diseases Ordinance No.3 of 1897, the said amendment Bill, but it has not yet been submitted to Parliament. Therefore, as per a proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media, the Cabinet approved to appoint a Review Committee to study the currently prepared Amendment Bill taking also into account the experiences gained during the recent pandemics and propose appropriate amendments to address current health challenges as well as future challenges.
